programme.title: Kedarnath
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of the 2013 floods in Uttarakhand, Kedarnath is an interfaith love story between Mandakini, a wealthy Hindu pilgrim, and Mansoor, a humble Muslim porter who carries her during her journey to the Kedarnath temple. Their growing romance faces opposition from society and family, ultimately tested by nature’s fury. The film blends spiritual, romantic, and disaster elements with emotional depth.

programme.title: Singh is King
programme.desc: Directed by Anees Bazmee, this action-comedy features Akshay Kumar as Happy Singh, whose journey from a village in Punjab to becoming a crime lord in Australia is filled with humor, action, and unexpected turns.

programme.title: Khamoshiyan
programme.desc: Kabir, a struggling writer, travels to Kashmir for inspiration and starts staying at a mysterious guest house. He falls in love with Meera, the owner of the guesthouse, who harbours a dark secret.

programme.title: Kalyug
programme.desc: Directed by Mohit Suri, Kalyug stars Kunal Khemu in his debut adult role. The film follows his character's descent into the pornographic underworld after a personal tragedy. As he seeks revenge, he uncovers the industry's seedy operations, leading to a gripping narrative about morality and redemption.

programme.desc: Directed by Ashwini Chaudhary, this coming-of-age drama features Emraan Hashmi and Tusshar Kapoor as students with contrasting personalities. When they switch places, chaos ensues, affecting their academic and personal lives. The film is a remake of the 1992 movie Class Act.
